hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(process.platform!=='win32'&&/(npm run dev\b|pnpm( run)? dev\b|yarn dev\b|bun run dev\b|wrangler dev\b)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux. Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"<cmd>\"');process.exit(2)}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Block dev servers outside tmux — prevents orphaned processes and ensures log access
